meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: Claude 会把有先后依赖的子任务定义成一张任务图,按一个阶段一个 run 并行推进;单个节点失败或跑偏时能重试、发消息或改定义来恢复,而且节点自称完成不算数,要拿出证据验证。
howto.when: 当你提到 mass-ulw、给出带依赖的任务图(DAG),或某些任务必须等另一些先完成的分批并发作业时,它会接管。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这三个有依赖的任务排成一张图跑
say.note: 它会先读规划文档再定义图

say.text: 把 audit 节点带上新提示词重试一遍
say.note: 只重跑该节点,已完成的复用

say.text: 给 lint 节点发消息:跳过 vendor 目录
say.note: 向运行中的子任务传话

howto.what_en: Claude turns dependency-ordered subtasks into a task graph and drives one phase per run, with per-node retry, send, and amend recovery. A node's completion claim counts only once proven against captured evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, hand it a task DAG, or need fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to run these three dependent tasks as one graph
say_en.note: It reads the planning doc first

say_en.text: Retry the audit node with a new prompt
say_en.note: Only that node re-runs; finished nodes are reused

say_en.text: Send the lint node: skip the vendored dir
say_en.note: Steers a running child in place
